title: Ninth Station: Jesus Falls the Third Time
text:
Consider the third fall of Jesus. His weakness was extreme, and the cruelty of His executioners excessive, as they tried to hurry Him when He had scarcely strength to move.

O my outraged Jesus, by the merits of the weakness Thou
didst suffer on Thy way to Calvary, give me strength to conquer
all human pride, and all my wicked passions, which have led me
to despise Thy friendship.
I love Thee, my Jesus; I love Thee more than myself; I am sorry
for having offended Thee. Never let me stray from Thee again.
Grant that I may always love Thee and do Thy will. Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
